Definition: of Latin origin; "silvan"; Silvanus, a Christian:--Silvanus. Compare G4609.
BiblicalUsage: Silouanos is Silvanus, the same man the book of Acts calls Silas. Paul names him beside himself and Timothy in the letters to the Thessalonians, and Peter says it was by Silvanus, a faithful brother, that he wrote briefly to testify that this is the true grace of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Silvanus shows me that one faithful man can carry two names and one calling, serving Paul in the missions and Peter in the letters.
